guide:
Inventory Advanced: Alternate Unit, Rejection, Reorder, Valuation

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Advanced Inventory की तैयारी

  • Alternate Unit: Create → Unit → Compound/Alternate बनाएँ (जैसे Box = 12 Pcs); फिर Stock Item में Alternate Unit और Conversion भरें।
  • Rejection In/Out: F11 में Order Processing/Inventory चालू करें और Voucher Types Activate करें (Rejection Out Ctrl+F5, Rejection In Ctrl+F6)।
  • Reorder Level: Stock Item में Reorder Level और Minimum Order Quantity भरें; Report: Stock Summary/Reorder Status।
  • Valuation Method: Stock Item → Costing Method (Avg Cost, FIFO, LIFO, Last Purchase Cost आदि) चुनें।
याद रखें

Conversion Factor सही भरें, वरना Stock गलत दिखेगा।

बढ़ती कीमत में FIFO से Profit ज़्यादा, LIFO से कम आता है।

Reorder Level से नीचे Stock जाते ही Reorder Status में दिखता है।

Problem 5Closing Qty = 300 − 150 = 150 Pcs

problems.title: Alternate Units — Box और Pcs
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

Stock Item 'Pen' का Primary Unit = Pcs, Alternate Unit = Box (1 Box = 12 Pcs)।

  • 1st April — Purchased 10 Box Pen @ ₹ 480 per Box
  • 2nd April — Sold 35 Pcs Pen @ ₹ 50 per Pcs
problems.hint:
• Unit बनाएँ: Pcs (Simple) और Box = 12 Pcs (Alternate Unit)।
  • Stock Item "Pen": Primary = Pcs, Alternate = Box, Conversion = 1 Box = 12 Pcs।
  • 1 Apr: Purchase 10 Box Pen @ 480/Box। 2 Apr: Sale 35 Pcs @ 50/Pcs।
problems.full:
मदहिसाब
Purchase10 Box = 120 Pcs; Cost ₹4,800 (₹40/Pcs)
Sale35 Pcs = 2 Box 11 Pcs; ₹1,750
Closing Stock120 − 35 = 85 Pcs = 7 Box 1 Pc; ₹3,400
Gross Profit1,750 − 35 × 40 = ₹350
✅ Check

Purchase = 120 Pcs, Cost ₹4,800 (₹40/Pcs) ✔

Sale = 35 Pcs (2 Box 11 Pcs) = ₹1,750 ✔

Closing Stock = 85 Pcs (7 Box 1 Pc) = ₹3,400 • Gross Profit = ₹350 ✔

problems.title: Rejection Out — Supplier को खराब माल वापसी
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • 1st April — Purchase Order No. PO-1: 100 Pcs Fan @ ₹ 1,500 (Supplier: Rathi Electricals)
  • 5th April — Goods Receipt Note: 100 Pcs received; Quality Check में 10 Pcs खराब पाए गए
  • 5th April — Rejection Out Voucher: 10 Pcs वापस भेजे; Purchase Bill केवल 90 Pcs का
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Purchase Order PO-1 (Rathi Electricals): Fan 100 @ 1,500।
  • 5 Apr: Receipt Note (Against PO-1): 100 Pcs आए।
  • 5 Apr: Quality Check में 10 Pcs खराब — Rejection Out (Ctrl+F5) से 10 Pcs वापस।
  • 5 Apr: Purchase Bill सिर्फ़ 90 Pcs का (90 × 1,500 = ₹1,35,000)।
problems.full:
✅ Check

Receipt Note के बाद Stock 100 Pcs, Rejection Out −10 → Net Stock 90 Pcs ✔

Purchase Bill = 90 × 1,500 = ₹1,35,000 ✔

Pending PO = 0 (10 Pcs की मात्रा रद्द मानें — Pre-Close — या नई Order दें) ✔

problems.title: Rejection In — Customer से खराब माल वापसी
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • 1st April — Opening: Mixer 80 Pcs @ ₹ 900 (Cost)
  • 2nd April — Sales Order & Delivery Note: 50 Pcs Mixer @ ₹ 1,300 to Kapoor Stores; Sales Invoice तैयार
  • 4th April — Kapoor ने 5 Pcs खराब बताकर लौटाए → Rejection In (Godown: Damaged Stock Godown) → Credit Note
problems.hint:
• Godown बनाएँ: Main Location और Damaged Stock Godown।
  • 1 Apr: Opening Mixer 80 @ 900 (Cost)।
  • 2 Apr: Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice: Kapoor Stores को 50 Pcs @ 1,300।
  • 4 Apr: Rejection In (Ctrl+F6): 5 Pcs, Godown = Damaged Stock Godown; फिर Credit Note।
problems.full:
मदहिसाब
Stock पहले80 − 50 = 30 Pcs
Rejection In के बाद30 + 5 = 35 Pcs (5 Damaged Godown में)
Credit Note5 × 1,300 = ₹6,500 (+ GST यदि लागू)
Net Sales45 × 1,300 = ₹58,500
✅ Check

Total Stock 35 Pcs (Main 30 + Damaged 5) ✔

Credit Note Value = ₹6,500 + GST (यदि लागू) ✔

Net Sales = 45 Pcs × ₹1,300 = ₹58,500 ✔

problems.title: Reorder Level & Minimum Order Quantity
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

Stock Item 'Notebook' में Reorder Level = 200 Pcs, Minimum Order Quantity = 300 Pcs सेट करें।

  • 1st April — Opening Stock: 450 Pcs
  • 5th April — Sold 180 Pcs
  • 10th April — Sold 90 Pcs
problems.hint:
• Stock Item "Notebook": Reorder Level = 200 Pcs; Minimum Order Quantity = 300 Pcs।
  • Opening Stock 450 Pcs। 5 Apr: Sale 180 Pcs। 10 Apr: Sale 90 Pcs।
  • जाँच: Display More Reports → Statements of Inventory → Reorder Status।
problems.full:
तारीख़Stockस्थिति
5 Apr के बाद450 − 180 = 270 Pcs200 से ऊपर — कोई Alert नहीं
10 Apr के बाद270 − 90 = 180 Pcs200 से नीचे — Reorder Status में दिखेगा
✅ Check

5 Apr के बाद Stock 270 Pcs (> Reorder Level) → कोई Alert नहीं ✔

10 Apr के बाद Stock 180 Pcs (< 200) → Reorder Status में दिखेगा ✔

कम से कम 300 Pcs का नया Purchase Order बनाना चाहिए ✔

problems.title: Stock Valuation — FIFO / Weighted Average / LIFO / Last Purchase Cost
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

  • 1st April — Purchased 100 Pcs @ ₹ 10
  • 10th April — Purchased 100 Pcs @ ₹ 12
  • 20th April — Purchased 100 Pcs @ ₹ 14
  • 25th April — Sold 150 Pcs @ ₹ 20

Closing Stock की Value चारों Method से निकालें और हर Method में Gross Profit बताएँ (Sales ₹ 3,000)।
problems.hint:
• Purchases: 1 Apr 100 @ 10; 10 Apr 100 @ 12; 20 Apr 100 @ 14। 25 Apr: Sale 150 @ 20 = ₹3,000।
  • Stock Item में Costing Method बदल-बदलकर (FIFO, Avg Cost, LIFO, Last Purchase Cost) Stock Summary से Closing Value देखें।

Closing Qty = 300 − 150 = 150 Pcs ✔

FIFO: COGS ₹1,600, Closing ₹2,000, GP ₹1,400 ✔ • Weighted Avg (₹12/Pc): COGS ₹1,800, Closing ₹1,800, GP ₹1,200 ✔
